reading: Russia freed US citizen Stephen Hubbard.
Donald Trump said the former teacher was released without any swap required.
A US envoy met Vladimir Putin in St Petersburg for talks.
Trump later said the man was on his way back home.
Trump said he made a request directly to Putin last week.
Hubbard was in poor health and needed treatment in Texas.
